title: wOS tool catalogue (tools.json)
description: Every action a person can take in a wOS app, written once. The suite serves each tool over MCP (/mcp), over REST (POST /api/tools/<name>) and to its own screens, all from the same handler. See packages/tools/README.md.

app.description: The app id from wos-app.json. Every tool name starts with it.

name.description: app.verb_noun in lower snake case after the dot, for example chat.post_message or crm.move_deal. A plain verb is fine when the noun is the app itself (agents.start).

title.description: Short sentence-case label, as a button would say it.

description.description: Plain words for a person and a model: what it does, when to use it, what comes back.

output.description: JSON Schema of the result. Use {"type":"object"} with properties; keep results small.

scope.description: What permission a caller needs. read: looks only. write: creates or changes. delete: removes. admin: team, billing, apps or hosting.

confirm.description: human: when an agent calls it, a person must say yes first (an approval lands in their inbox). A person clicking the button in a screen is the yes.

emits.description: Event names this tool may publish, app.noun.past_verb, for example chat.message.posted.

test.description: Path, relative to the app root, of the test that exercises this tool. The suite's catalogue test fails when it is missing.

public.description: Callable without sign-in (rare: sign-in links, health). Default false.

hidden.description: Not offered to models by default (still callable). For tools that only make sense from a screen, such as saving a panel layout.

objectSchema.description: JSON Schema of the input. Always an object, so MCP clients and OpenAPI accept it.
